messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: canary 'wave-5' in us-west-2 — sustained 5xx rate 2.8% over 3m, p95 latency +120ms. Abort condition met (canary_abort_threshold). Paging on-call.

julia-oncall: I'm on it, investigating. Starting with router + model-worker metrics. Paging @matt.

matt: Ack. Pulling logs from canary pods. Running: `kubectl logs -l canary=wave-5 -n inference --since=5m`

matt: Seeing a cluster of 503s from model-worker-quant nodes and repeated `cudaAlloc` errors in the logs. Possible memory regression on quantized kernel.

susan-sre: If real worker OOMs -> flip the canary feature flag to stop traffic to wave-5. We have an emergency kill-switch for feature flags. Recommend flip now to reduce customer blast radius.

julia-oncall: Do it. Also prepare rollback if flag flip doesn't improve within 2 minutes.

matt: Flipping flag: `curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API' https://flags.internal/flip -d '{"flag":"canary-wave-5","state":"off"}'` — response 200. (recorded)

incident-bot: ACTION_LOG: feature-flag flip recorded by matt at 1809993368.

julia-oncall: 60s after flip — 5xx rate dropped to 0.7%, p95 latency near baseline. :white_check_mark: Monitoring for stabilization window (15m).

carol-support: Reached out to support ops. No inbound customer reports yet. We'll notify if anything comes in.

matt: Paste from worker log: ```ERR model_worker: cudaAlloc failed: out of memory at src/backend/quant_kernels.cu:412
Stack: ...
Pod: model-worker-quant-7f8db9``` Suspect quant kernel selection changed in this rollout for long-seq traffic.

susan-sre: Good catch. Triage items: 1) pin quant kernel selection for canary models, 2) add unit/regression test for seq-length>1024 on quant path, 3) follow-up postmortem.

pm-alex: Flag flip is good immediate mitigation. Please add short customer-facing blurb if we get escalations. Also block further rollouts until dev + infra sign-off.

julia-oncall: Agree. Scheduling a rollback only if we see re-escalation. Handoff: I'll be on-call for the next 45m to watch the 15m stabilization window, then hand to day oncall.

matt: I'll open bug with logs + reproducer and tag infra/ml-runtime. Owner: matt. Quick fix plan: revert kernel selector change in canary release and re-evaluate in staging.

susan-sre: If any recurrence, execute full rollback to previous release (rollout_cancel + traffic-shift). For now keep rollout blocked.

carol-support: Noted. I'll prepare a short incident note for support playbook in case customers ask: "We observed elevated errors during a canary rollout; mitigation applied, no customer impact reported so far."

julia-oncall: Thanks. Closing active pager for now but leaving monitoring on. Will update channel if anything changes.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: canary-abort -> mitigation applied (flag flipped). Monitoring window in progress. Next update at 1809994260 or earlier if changes.
